messages.subject: Project Ironvale - draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Margaret, Daniel,

Attached are draft Heads of Terms for Project Ironvale. Key points: EV £42.5m cash-free/debt-free, normalised working capital £3.6m, £2m escrow for 18 months, 8-week exclusivity, completion targeted 12 December. Grateful for comments before we send to Hargrove.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
